title: Inspector does not display properties of Refcounted instances created in the debugger evaluator
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.5.beta1.
Not reproducible in: 4.4.1.stable (attempting to reproduce seems to trigger the bug solved by #97647, so this bug is irrelevant there).

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v4.5.beta1

### Issue description

When the debugger evaluator outputs an instance:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/56cc4b92-0e8d-4813-98a6-d875437ae170)

I would expect that double clicking on it would make the instance's properties appear in the inspector, like so:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c65e8a22-7706-40ba-b766-ce52ed9ad777)

But instead, this **does not** work when the class does not inherit from `Object` (i.e. inherits directly from `RefCounted`).
In such a case, double clicking on the evaluated instance empties the Inspector view:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ce98ae1a-3028-485d-a33b-333d07d081bb)

### Important notes:
1. Attempting to access a property of the instance directly in the evaluator, **does work** (see image below). So the object is created correctly, and the issue seems to be specifically with the Evaluator's interaction with the Inspector.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5a8a052f-9686-47da-b184-6a4a490561f6)
2. If the class inherits from Object, the Inspector acts as expected.
3. If the instance exists in the locals (i.e. was NOT created through the Evaluator), the Inspector acts as expected.

### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce + observed behavior:
1. Create a class that does not extend from anything (or that extends directly from RefCounted)
2. In the debugger evaluator, create an instance of this class.
3. Double click the result in an attempt to view the properties of this class in the Inspector.
Observed behavior: The result **does not** appear in the inspector.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-evaluator-instance-bugs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20843014/godot-evaluator-instance-bugs.zip)
